name: u9-shield-bob-standing
description: ⛓⛓⛓ U9-swim D2(c) — A STANDING SHIELD BUMPS NOTHING. L4, spawn (56,56), diagonal to `bob@64,64` (ctor (72,72)), the SHIELD granted through the seam and `noDamage` FALSE, no keys for 100 ticks. `Player.shieldBump` is gated on `v.length > 0`: the bob chases onto the down-facing 7x7 shield box and sits on it for 23 tick(s) from t 36 without a shove, until its body reaches the player's and the contact lands (t 58). On that tick the bob IS shoved: `hitPlayer` wrote the knockback into the player's `v` earlier in the frame, so `v.length > 0` holds, and the box is still where the previous frame's render left it, facing down (t 58). A model without the gate would shove the bob off the box from the first touch and the contact would not land where it does. Authored by scripts/procgen/plan-seedling-u9-shield-bump.mjs.
